headline: Côte d'Ivoire raises 55 billion FCFA on the WAEMU financial market
summary: Côte d'Ivoire raised 55 billion CFA francs in a simultaneous auction of 364-day Treasury bills and 3-, 5- and 7-year bonds on the UMOA market on 17 November 2026.
why: The UMOA (WAEMU) regional market lets member states borrow in CFA francs from a shared pool of investors. Auction results indicate government funding costs in the region.
original_headline: La Côte d’Ivoire lève 55 milliards FCFA sur le marché financier de l’UMOA
